tips.timer: On: each move has a voting time (10 to 120s), then the move is picked (wheel or majority). Off: no timer, the FIRST vote received is played immediately, and the other voting settings don't apply.
tips.turnDuration: How long chat has to vote on each move, from 10 to 120s. Mind the stream delay: 30s is a good start.
tips.wheelDuration: Length of the wheel animation that draws the move among the votes.
tips.votesPerViewer: How many different moves a viewer can suggest each turn. Stats only count them once per move.
tips.majority: On: the most voted move is played. Off: a wheel draw, each vote gives the move a chance.
tips.restrictions: Limit votes to followers and/or subscribers. The streamer, mods and VIPs can always vote. Followers requires allowing follower access when connecting Twitch.
tips.rushRating: Difficulty of the first puzzle. It goes up with each solved puzzle.
tips.rushPause: Wait between two puzzles, to breathe and look at the solution.
tips.rushMode: Time to find each move. Each time has its own leaderboard.
tips.problemThemes: Kinds of puzzles (mate in 2, fork, pin…). None selected: every theme.
tips.monoColor: The side you play on the board; registered viewers vote for the other one.
tips.voteTime: How long chat has to vote on each move.
tips.choice: Random: random draw weighted by votes. Majority: the most voted move is played.
tips.multiPublic: Public: listed in Browse, any channel can join. Private: anyone can watch, but only the channel with your link can join.
tips.anonymity: Visible: usernames and votes shown live. Hidden names: you see the voted moves, not who voted them. Secret vote: nothing during the turn (no podium, no arrow, no names), the result shows up at the draw or when the move is played. Votes are still written in the Twitch chat: hide it on your stream for a truly blind vote.
tips.anonymityMulti: You choose for both channels: your opponent must follow this setting. Visible: usernames and votes live. Hidden names: the voted moves without usernames. Secret vote: nothing during the turn, the result shows up at the draw or when the move is played.
tips.chroma: Replaces the page background with a solid colour you can key out in OBS with a "Chroma Key" filter. Pick a colour that isn't on the board or pieces (green by default).

phantom.repairTitle: Pieces placed off-center: factory reset, then put back in place
phantom.repairQ: Is the board placing pieces off-center?
phantom.repairText: If every piece is off by the same amount and the log keeps showing sensor errors, the mechanism is out of sync. The repair restores the Phantom's factory settings (which re-centers the carriage), reconnects it on its own, then puts the pieces back. Allow about a minute.
phantom.repairConfirm:
Repair the Phantom's centering?

Use this when pieces are placed off the center of the squares (same offset everywhere, sensor errors over and over).

The Phantom goes back to its factory settings, restarts, reconnects on its own, then puts the pieces back. Allow about a minute; the speed setting is kept.
